look.lens_and_camera: Natural focal lengths, a steady mounted camera, deep focus in wides.
look.framing: Classical framing with clear headroom; the horizon kept level.
look.multi_character_framing: Two or more characters share the frame in depth, never stacked.
look.daylight: One soft directional source from a window or the sky, little fill.
look.night: Practical sources only; shadows allowed to fall toward black.
look.interiors_sealed_light: Light from the room's own practicals, motivated and low.
look.color_contrast_texture: Restrained colour, medium contrast, fine grain.
